inputSchema.title: UpdateItemRequest

value.title: Value
value.description: New column value as a JSON-serializable object or string. This will be stringified for the GraphQL mutation. For text/number/name columns, send a plain string; for complex columns like status/timeline/people, send a JSON object (e.g., {"index": 1}).

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: ID of the item to update.

board_id.title: Board Id
board_id.description: ID of the board containing the item.

column_id.title: Column Id
column_id.description: The unique identifier of the column to change.

create_labels_if_missing.title: Create Labels If Missing
create_labels_if_missing.description: If true, creates missing labels for Status/Dropdown columns when the label does not exist. Requires permission to change board structure.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating an existing item's column value on Monday.com.
